name: maplint
description: Experimental mapper-agnostic JS/TS linter using TypeScript 7.1 content mappers

scripts.lint: npm run build && node ./dist/bin/maplint.js --project examples/demo/tsconfig.json --allow-external examples/demo/src --json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && node ./dist/bin/maplint.js --project examples/demo/tsconfig.json --allow-external --typecheck examples/demo/src
